searchText: MSRP $272,460. New 2026 Leisure Travel Unity 24MBL Luxury Class C RV. Features Murphy Bed Truma Varioheat Furnace Black Accent Package Overhead Cabinet Door Upgrade Solar Panels Alcoa Aluminum Wheels Exterior Table Exterior Entertainment Package Lithium Battery Upgrade More About This RV Traveling will be convenient and comfortable with this versatile Murphy bed and redesigned leisure lounge, which includes dual reclining chairs, an updated dinette table and a large panoramic window! At night, the lounge seating is hidden as you flip-down the Murphy bed for a comfortable night's rest. In the morning, tuck it all away to bring back your living space. You will also enjoy the convenient kitchen amenities in place so you can easily whip up a meal or snack while you are stopped, and for overnight you can get refreshed for a new day in the rear bath featuring a radius shower with a skylight, a sink, and closet space for your things. Each Unity Class B+ diesel motorhome by Leisure Travel sits on a durable Mercedes-Benz Sprinter 3500 dual rear wheel chassis with a 2.0-L Turbocharged I-4 diesel engine to power your adventures. The powder coated steel undercarriage support structure and vacuum-bonded construction provide a coach that will last for years, and there are sleek exterior paint options to make the coach your own. You'll love driving the Unity with its electronic stability control, adaptive cruise control, 9-speed automatic transmission with quieter noise levels and more comfort. The luxurious interior includes Ultrafabrics, a contoured solid surface Corian countertop in the kitchen, modern cabinetry finishes, plus many more comforts. And all of your power need will be met with 270-Ah 12V Lithium coach batteries with an internal heating system, plus a 3000W pure sine inverter and a 30 Amp power cord.
